'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Alex O'Shea DS Combat Readiness''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Alex O'Shea]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name on sheet: Three-for-all.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Combat Readiness|Combat Readiness (V)]]
* '''Username:''' Thursday
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
